issues.message: Waveguide port 'left': max measurement frequency 12.400 GHz exceeds 0.90 × fc_next=11.803 GHz on the REALIZED guide (22.8600 x 10.1600 mm, declared geometry (non-uniform mesh)) (fc_TE10=6.557 GHz, fc_TE20=13.114 GHz). Evanescent TE20 contamination may exceed 1 % and registers as |S11| < 1 in a lossless structure. Restrict measurement freqs below 11.803 GHz or increase port-to-obstacle distance.
